10901.commentary: (ANa) imāni cattāri ahirājakulānī'ti idaṃ daṭṭhavisān'eva sandhāya vuttaṃ. ye hi keci daṭṭhavisā, sabb'ete imesaṃ catunnaṃ ahirājakulānaṃ abbhantaragatā'va honti.

examples.text: na hi nūna so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari. sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya.

10902.meaningLit: discourse on king of the snakes

10903.construction:
na > a + √hir + ī + ka
ahirī + ka

examples.text: rosako kadariyo ca, pāp'iccho maccharī saṭho, ahiriko anottappī, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
sujīvaṃ ahirikena, kākasūrena dhaṃsinā, pakkhandinā pagabbhena, saṃkiliṭṭhena jīvitaṃ.

10904.construction:
na > a + √hir + i + ka
na + hiri + ka
10904.commentary: (DNa) ahirikan'ti yaṃ na hirīyati hirīyitabbenā'ti (dha. sa. 1328) evaṃ vitthāritā nillajjatā. anottappan'ti yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbenā'ti (dha. sa. 1329) evaṃ vitthārito abhāyanaka-ākāro.

examples.text: ahirikañ'ca anottappañ'ca.

10905.grammar: fem, abstr, from na hirika, neg
10905.meaning1: shamelessness; fact of being without conscience
10905.construction:
na > a + √hir + ī + ka + tā
ahirika + tā

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca assaddho hoti, parañ'ca assaddhiye samādapeti, attanā ca ahiriko hoti, parañ'ca ahirikatāya samādapeti, attanā ca anottappī hoti, parañ'ca anottappe samādapeti, attanā ca appassuto hoti, parañ'ca appassute samādapeti…

10906.meaningLit: discourse on rooted in lack of conscience

10909.grammar: fem, abstr, from na hirika, neg
10909.construction:
na > a + √hir + ī + ka + tā
ahirikka + tā

examples.text: n'āhaṃ alakkhyā ahirikkatāya vā, na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā, ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā.

10910.construction:
na > a + √hir + ī + ka
ahirī + ka

examples.text: saṅghalābhassa bhaṇḍanti, saṅghato paribāhirā, paralābho-pajīvantā, ahirīkā na lajjare.

10911.meaning1: ?? plague; cholera; deadly and contagious disease
10911.commentary: (VINa) ahivātakarogenā'ti māribyādhinā, yatra hi so rogo uppajjati, taṃ kulaṃ dvipadacatuppadaṃ sabbaṃ nassati, yo bhittiṃ vā chadanaṃ vā bhinditvā palāyati, tirogām'ādigato vā hoti, so muccati. (PYt) iminā ahivātakarogenā'ti ettha ahivisasadisena vātena pavatto rogo ahivātakarogo'ti vuccatī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ahivātakarogena kālaṅ'kataṃ hoti. tassa pitāputtakā sesā honti.
appamāṇo buddho, appamāṇo dhammo, appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni. ahivicchikā satapadī, uṇṇanābhī sarabū mūsikā, katā me rakkhā katā me parittā, paṭikkamantu bhūtāni.

10913.meaning1: knowledge of snakes; (comm) art of curing snake bites; (or) the art of summoning snakes

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… aṅgavijjā vatthuvijjā khattavijjā sivavijjā bhūtavijjā bhūrivijjā ahivijjā visavijjā vicchikavijjā mūsikavijjā sakuṇavijjā vāyasavijjā pakkajjhānaṃ saraparittāṇaṃ migacakkaṃ

10914.construction:
na > a + hiṃsa + a + ka
ahiṃsa + ka

examples.text: ahiṃsakā ye munayo, niccaṃ kāyena saṃvutā, te yanti accutaṃ ṭhānaṃ, yattha gantvā na socare.

10915.meaning1: name of Brahman, and later an arahant monk
10915.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
10915.commentary: (SNa) ahiṃsakabhāradvājo'ti bhāradvājo'v'esa, ahiṃsakapañhaṃ pana pucchi, ten'ass'etaṃ saṅgītikārehi nāmaṃ gahitaṃ. nāmena vā esa ahiṃsako, gottena bhāradvājo.

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho ahiṃsakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ahiṃsak'āhaṃ, bho gotama, ahiṃsak'āhaṃ, bho gotamā'ti.

10917.grammar: fem, abstr, from na hiṃsati, neg (+dat)

examples.text: yamhi saccañ'ca dhammo ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo, sa ve vantamalo dhīro, thero iti pavuccati.
na tena ariyo hoti, yena pāṇāni hiṃsati, ahiṃsā sabbapāṇānaṃ, ariyo'ti pavuccati.

10918.commentary: (DNa) ahīn'indriyan'ti saṇṭhānavasena avikal'indriyaṃ. iddhimatā nimmitarūpañ'hi sace iddhimā odāto tam'pi odātaṃ. sace aviddhakaṇṇo tam'pi aviddhakaṇṇan'ti evaṃ sabbākārehi tena sadisam'eva hoti.

examples.text: manomayaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyan'ti. manomayo ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa sabbaṅgapaccaṅgī ahīn'indriyo, evaṃ santam'pi kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.

10919.meaning1: not defective in any sense; with fully functional faculties

examples.text: saññā nu kho, manomayaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyan'ti. manomayo ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa sabbaṅgapaccaṅgī ahīn'indriyo, evaṃ santam'pi kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.
katamo manomayo attapaṭilābho? rūpī manomayo sabbaṅgapaccaṅgī ahīn'indriyo, ayaṃ manomayo attapaṭilābho. katamo arūpo attapaṭilābho? arūpī saññāmayo, ayaṃ arūpo attapaṭilābho.

10920.meaning1: not scorned; not looked down on; not despised

examples.text: ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, buddhappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, dhammappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, saṅghappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
idha bhikkhu ekaccassa evaṃ hoti, ahu vata me, taṃ vata me n'atthi, siyā vata me, taṃ vat'āhaṃ na labhāmī'ti.
ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi, āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissi.

10922.grammar: aor, reflx 1st sg of ahosi, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: samaṇassa ahu cintā, pupphitamhi mahāvane, ek'aggassa nisinnassa, pavivittassa jhāyino.

10923.synonym: aṇha, anha, aha, dina, diva, divasa

examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
tadahu pabbajito santo, jātiyā sattavassiko, so'pi maṃ anusāseyya, sampaṭicchāmi matthake.

10925.grammar: abs of na hoti, neg, intrans (+nom)
10925.meaning1: having not been; having not existed

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ kira'me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī'ti. so tesu dhammesu anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharati.

10927.commentary: (VINa) ahu'd'evā'ti ahu eva, dakāro padasandhikaro. ahosi'y'evā'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, ahu'd'eva kaṅkhā, ahu vicikicchā, kathaṃ nāma samaṇassa gotamassa dhammo abhiññeyyo'ti ?
etāni, bhikkhu, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññ'āgārāni. jhāyatha, bhikkhu, mā pamād'attha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī'ti.
cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha, mā anubyañjanaggāhino.
virato methunā dhammā, brahmacārī nirāmiso, ahuvā te sagāmeyyo, ahuvā te pure sakhā.

10930.meaning1: roar of laughter; laughing out loud
10930.construction:
anu > ahu + √has > hās + *a + iya
ahuhāsa + iya

examples.text: k'āyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe, karoti ahuhāsiyaṃ, na'y'idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā, tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhikāle sussoṇi, kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhaṇe.

10931.meaning1: (used to address equals) friend; love; dear

examples.text: sakko ce me varaṃ dajjā, tāvatiṃsānam'issaro, t'āhaṃ bhadde vareyya-ahe, evaṃ kāmo daḷho mama.

10932.meaning1: not harming; not hurting; not harassing; not hassling

examples.text: na pāṇidaṇḍehi pan'ātha leḍḍunā, satthena vā maraṇavadhena vā pana, ubbādhanāya paritajjanāya vā, na heṭhayī janatam'aheṭhako ahu.

10933.grammar: prp of na heṭhayati, neg, trans (+acc)
10933.meaning1: not harming; not hurting; not disturbing

examples.text: yathā'pi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandham'aheṭhayaṃ, paleti rasam'ādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
yo pāṇabhūtāni aheṭhayaṃ caraṃ, par'ūpavādā na karonti pāpaṃ, bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na hi tattha sūraṃ, bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpan'ti.

10934.grammar: prp of na heṭhayati, neg, trans (+acc)
10934.meaning1: not harming; not hurting; not disturbing

examples.text: kummo aṅgāni sake kapāle, samodahaṃ bhikkhu manovitakke, anissito aññam'aheṭhayāno, parinibbuto n'ūpavadeyya kañcī'ti.

10935.meaning1: causeless; with no basis; for no reason
10935.commentary: (DNa) tassa saññ'uppāde ca nirodhe ca hetuṃ apassanto, ahetū appaccayā'ti āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti? tatr'ekacce evam'āhaṃsu, ahetū appaccayā purisassa saññā uppajjanti'pi nirujjhanti'pi. yasmiṃ samaye uppajjanti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti.

pūraṇo, bhante, kassapo evam'āha, n'atthi hetu n'atthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya, ahetū appaccayā sattā saṃkilissanti. n'atthi hetu n'atthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā, ahetū appaccayā sattā visujjhantī'ti. idha, bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

10936.meaning1: not a cause; not a reason; not a basis (for)

examples.text: n'atthi hetu, n'atthi paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya. ahetu, appaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hotī'ti. idha bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

10937.meaning1: (the belief that the world is) without cause or condition

examples.text: ahetuappaccayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sārato paccāgacchataṃ na hoti chando vā vāyāmo vā idaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ idaṃ vā akaraṇīyan'ti. iti karaṇīy'ākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo.
santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, yaṃ kiñc'āyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ ahetu-appaccayā'ti.

10939.construction:
na > a + √hi > he + *tu + ka
ahetu + ka

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ ukkalā vassabhaññā ahetukavādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā, te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.

10940.construction:
na > a + √hi > he + *tu + ka
ahetu + ka

10941.meaning2: view that nothing has a reason, cause

10942.meaning1: following the doctrine of non-causality; adhering to the theory that nothing has a reason
10942.commentary: (SNa) ahetukavādā'ti-ādīsu n'atthi hetu n'atthi paccayo'ti gahitattā ahetukavādā.

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ ukkalā vassabhaññā ahetukavādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā, te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.

kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu hetu, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, dussīlo purisapuggalo micchādiṭṭhi ahetukavādo'ti.

10943.meaning1: (proponent of) doctrine of non-causality; theory that nothing has a reason
10943.commentary: (MNa) ahetuvādā'ti n'atthi hetu n'atthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā'ti evam'ādivādino.

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ okkalā vassabhaññā ahetuvādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā te'pi mahācattārīsakaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na garahitabbaṃ napaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.
api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā pubb'antaṃ vā paṭidhāveyyātha, ahesumha nu kho mayaṃ atītam'addhānaṃ, nanu kho ahesumha atītam'addhānaṃ, kiṃ nu kho ahesumha atītam'addhānaṃ
evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī'ti.
kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.

10946.meaning1: oh dear!; oh no!; oh bother!

examples.text: so gehā nikkhamitvā… akkhīni me dhūmāyantī'ti vatvā nalāṭe hatthaṃ ṭhapetvā uddhaṃ oloketvā, aho dukkhaṃ, ayyo no mahākassapatthero cirassaṃ me kuṭidvāraṃ āgato, atthi nu kho kiñci gehe'ti āha

10947.meaning1: ah yes!; surely it must be!; I can't believe it's not!

examples.text: evaṃ vutte tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva ārabbha sati udapādi, aho nūna bhagavā, aho nūna sugato, yo imesaṃ dhammānaṃ sukusalo'ti. bhagavā, bhante, kusalo, bhagavā pakataññū abhisaññānirodhassa.

eso nu te, mārisa, so bhagavā satthā'ti? na kho me, mārisa, so bhagavā satthā. sabrahmacārī me eso āyasmā mahāmoggallāno'ti. lābhā te, mārisa, suladdhaṃ te, mārisa yassa te sabrahmacārī evaṃmah'iddhiko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo! aho nūna te so bhagavā satthā'ti.

so tasmiṃ purise kāruññaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anuddayaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anukampaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, aho vat'āyaṃ puriso labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, labheyya gām'antanāyakaṃ!
idha cunda ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ anabhijjhitā hoti, aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mam'assā'ti

10949.meaning1: (expressing contempt) oh aren't you a!; you're a fine example of!

examples.text: aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitakā, aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutakā, aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjakā
accayena ahorattaṃ, padum'uttaranāmako sabbaṃ tamaṃ vinodetvā, loke uppajji cakkhumā.

10951.meaning1: (expressing pleasure, surprise, or disbelief) oh!; wow!
10951.commentary: (UDa) aho sukhaṃ aho sukhan'ti somanassasahitaṃ ñāṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ pītisamuṭṭhānaṃ samuggirati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā bhaddiyo kāḷīgodhāya putto araññagato'pi rukkhamūlagato'pi suññ'āgāragato'pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi, aho sukhaṃ, aho sukhan'ti!
aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjaka

10952.synonym: api, assudaṃ, kāmaṃ, khalu, khu, kho, taggha, nuna, nūna, byā, vata, ve, vo, sudaṃ, ssa, ha, have, hi

examples.text: aho nūna bhagavā, aho nūna sugato yo imesaṃ dhammānaṃ sukusalo'ti

10953.meaning1: day and night; days and nights; time

examples.text: accayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ uparujjhati, āyu khīyati maccānaṃ, kunnadīnaṃ'va odakaṃ.
kusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, ten'eva tvaṃ, rāhula, pītipāmojjena vihareyyāsi ahoratta-anusikkhī kusalesu dhammesu.

10955.meaning1: tireless throughout the day and night; energetic all the time

examples.text: evaṃ vihārim'ātāpiṃ, ahorattam'atanditaṃ. taṃ ve bhadd'ekaratto'ti, santo ācikkhate muni.

10956.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ahoratta
10956.commentary: (ITIa) ahorattan'ti divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, sabbakālan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: evaṃ vihāriṃ ātāpiṃ, ahorattam'atanditaṃ. taṃ ve bhadd'ekaratto'ti, santo ācikkhate munī'ti.
evaṃ vihārī ātāpī, ahorattam'atandito, bhāvayaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, yogakkhemassa pattiyā.

10957.meaning1: passing of days and nights; passage of time

examples.text: vanaṃ yadaggi ḍahati, pāvako kaṇhavattanī, jāyanti tattha pārohā, ahorattānam'accaye.

10958.meaning1: training day and night (in); practising (something) continuously

examples.text: kusalaṃ idaṃ vacīkammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, ten'eva tvaṃ, rāhula, pītipāmojjena vihareyyāsi ahoratt'ānusikkhī kusalesu dhammesu.

sace pan'āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti, na kho'mhi pāp'iccho, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato'ti, ten'āvuso, bhikkhunā ten'eva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahoratt'ānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.

10960.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ahoratti

examples.text: divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā, sannaddho khattiyo tapati, jhāyī tapati brāhmaṇo, atha sabbam'ahorattiṃ, buddho tapati tejasā.
etha bhikkhavo'ti bhagavā avoca. svākkhāto dhammo caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā'ti. sā'va tesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ upasampadā ahosi
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo sāy'anhasamayaṃ anunadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi. siṅgālopi kho, bhikkhave, sāy'anhasamayaṃ anunadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi.

10962.meaning2: act of thought which has no longer any potential force

10963.meaning2: lapsed kamma (i.e. kamma that has been performed and has not and will not have ripening)

examples.text: na me hoti ahosin'ti, bhavissan'ti na hoti me, saṅkhārā vigamissanti, tattha kā paridevanā.
ahosiṃ nu kho ahaṃ atītam'addhānaṃ? na nu kho ahosiṃ atītam'addhānaṃ? kiṃ nu kho ahosiṃ atītam'addhānaṃ? kathaṃ nu kho ahosiṃ atītam'addhānaṃ? kiṃ hutvā kiṃ ahosiṃ nu kho ahaṃ atītam'addhānaṃ?

10966.meaning1: oh!; oh no!; oh dear!; good grief!
10966.commentary: (THa) aho vatā no amarā'ti c'āhū'ti aho vata amhākaṃ ñātī amarā siyun'ti ca kathenti, gāthāsukh'atthañ'h'ettha vatā-iti dīghaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, ahovatā no amarā'ti c'āhu, vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samādhāya tatoḍahanti.
yaññad'eva hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya taṃ tadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kathalena vā sañchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ.

10970.synonym: koṭṭhāsa, khaṇḍa, desa, paṭivisa, paṭiviṃsa, padesa, bhāga

examples.text: yāva'd'eva anatthāya, ñattaṃ bālassa jāyati, hanti bālassa sukka-aṃsaṃ, muddham'assa vipātayaṃ.
atha kiñ'carahi ty'āyaṃ, sāriputta, uḷārā āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, eka-aṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito
seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
cit'antar'aṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

tatiyam'pi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante pacchime yāme, uddhaste aruṇe, nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāy'āsanā eka-aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

10974.commentary: (PMa) aṃsakūṭato'ti ettha abbhuggat'aṭṭhena kūṭo viyā'ti kūṭo, aṃso'y'eva kūṭo aṃsakūṭo.

examples.text: ete'pi hi appicchā'va santuṭṭhā'va subharā'va sallahukavuttino'va. bhagavā pana na y'imaṃ suttaṃ tesaṃ vasena kathesi, aṭṭhaparikkhārikassa vasena kathesi. so hi khuddakavāsiñ'ca sūciñ'ca parissāvane pakkhipitvā pattassa anto ṭhapetvā pattaṃ aṃsakūṭe laggetvā ticīvaraṃ kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ katvā yen'icchakaṃ sukhaṃ pakkamati.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni, aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena aṃs'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena dant'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ.
anāpatti āyoge, kāyabandhane, aṃsabaddhake, pattathavikāya, parissāvane, bibbohanaṃ karoti, aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā uddāletvā paribhuñjati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
anāpatti, cīvaraṃ sibbetuṃ, āyoge, kāyabandhane, aṃsabandhake, pattatthavikāya, parissāvane, ñātakānaṃ, pavāritānaṃ, aññass'atthāya, attano dhanena, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pakkhandikā sūlā visūcikā kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso soso apamāro daddu kaṇḍu kacchu nakhasā vitacchikā lohitaṃ pittaṃ madhumeho aṃsā piḷakā bhagandalā
kārāpeyyā'ti ekena'pi kosiy'aṃsunā missitvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ. paṭilābhena nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

pa, parā, ni, nī, u, du, saṃ, vi, ava, anu, pari, adhi, abhi, pati, su, ā, ati, api, apa, upa, pahāro, parābhavo, nihāro, nīhāro, uhāro, duhāro, saṃhāro, vihāro, avahāro, anuhāro, parihāro, adhihāro, abhihāro, patihāro, suhāro, āhāro, atihāro, apihāro, apahāro, upahāro, evaṃ vīsati upasaggehi ca.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ

10988.synonym: icchati, jigiṃsati, jigīsati, patthayati, pattheti, pāṭikaṅkhati

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.
bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto, ākaṅkhe ce hadayass'ānupattiṃ, lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañ'ca, sucetaso anissito tadānisaṃso'ti.

10990.synonym: aṭṭhiya, atthika, atthiya, abhikaṅkhamāna, ākaṅkhamāna, icchanta, icchamāna, patthayanta, patthayamāna, patthayāna
10990.commentary: (DHPa) tasmā'ti yasmā tasiṇāya purakkhatā paliveṭhitā sattā, tasmā attano virāgaṃ rāg'ādivigamaṃ nibbānaṃ patthento ākaṅkamāno bhikkhu arahattamaggen'etaṃ tasiṇaṃ vinodaye panuditvā nīharitvā chaḍḍeyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: sace, bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti
tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bandhito. tasmā tasiṇaṃ vinodaye, bhikkhu ākaṅkha'virāgam'attano.

10991.synonym: aṭṭhiya, atthika, atthiya, abhikaṅkhamāna, ākaṅkhanta, icchanta, icchamāna

examples.text: bahū devā manussā ca, maṅgalāni acintayuṃ, ākaṅkhamānā sotthānaṃ, brūhi maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
maccherā ca pamādā ca, evaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati, puññaṃ ākaṅkhamānena, deyyaṃ hoti vijānatā'ti.
so sace ākaṅkhiṃ, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ … yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyan'ti, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.

atha kho soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi, yaṃ vata no ahosi icchitaṃ, yaṃ ākaṅkhitaṃ, yaṃ adhippetaṃ, yaṃ abhipatthitaṃ, aho vata maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya, addhā vat'ass'āhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā'ti

yato kho, gahapatayo, ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti imehi catūhi ākaṅkhiyehi ṭhānehi, so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto, sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti.
tattha yāni suttāni bhagavā parehi anajjhiṭṭho kevalaṃ attano ajjh'āsayena kathesi. seyyath'idaṃ, ākaṅkheyyasuttaṃ vatthasuttan'ti evam'ādīni, tesaṃ att'ajjhāsayo nikkhepo.
